scope: Blocker esterni non chiudibili nel container Emergent. Checklist operative finali per l'utente.

google_client_ids_creation: Google Cloud Console -> APIs & Services -> Credentials
Create OAuth client Android (package name + SHA-1 release)
Create OAuth client iOS (bundle id reale)
Create OAuth client Web (per audience check backend)
apple_services_id_creation: Apple Developer Account -> Identifiers -> Services IDs
Create App ID con Sign in with Apple capability
Create Services ID + Key ID + Team ID
Generate Private Key (.p8) per identity token validation
dev_build_requirements: Expo development build (non Expo Go) per provider sign-in nativo
id_token_verification_test_steps: 1. Login utente da app -> ricevi id_token
4. Reject se invalid (no fallback to client claims)

required_pages: Account Deletion Instructions (GDPR Art.17 + Google Play / Apple Store requirement)
minimum_content: Privacy: data collected, purposes, lawful basis, retention, sharing, user rights, contact DPO
Terms: service description, accounts, prohibited conduct, IP, disclaimers, governing law
Account Deletion: step-by-step how to request, verification, grace period 30gg, hard delete confirmation
privacy_terms_account_deletion_urls.staging_url_minimum: https://staging.<dominio>/privacy puo bastare per Closed Alpha private testing
privacy_terms_account_deletion_urls.live_url_required_for_store: Production URL su dominio legale obbligatorio per Google Play + Apple Store
where_to_configure: frontend app.json/expo extra -> URL link nel login + settings

android_checklist: Install via Google Play Internal Testing track
Login guest OK + session restore dopo killapp
Live hub + bot status panel + chat preview + announcements
Screenshot + adb logcat richiesti come proof
ios_checklist: Sign in with Apple button visibility (App Store requirement)
Screenshot + Xcode console logs richiesti come proof
pass_fail_criteria: Combat scene render senza freeze/crash = PASS
Crash test recovery senza data loss = PASS
deliverables_expected: performance metrics (cold start ms, scene transition ms)

external_environment_requirements: staging cluster dedicato con DB MongoDB isolato
almeno 4 vCPU + 8GB RAM per locust master + workers
full_load_locust_1000.db_write_safety: users collection only (auth/account), NESSUNA economy/inventory/reward write

google_play_internal_track: Sign release APK/AAB con keystore release
apple_testflight_track: Create App Store Connect app entry
Build via Xcode/EAS con cert distribution
required_signing_credentials: Android: keystore release (.jks) + storePassword + keyAlias + keyPassword
iOS: AppStore Connect API key (.p8) + Distribution Certificate + Provisioning Profile
data_safety: Google Play Data Safety: collected data minimum (account id + provider id only)
Apple Privacy questionnaire: 'Data Not Linked to You' per analytics, 'Account' per auth
app_access_instructions: Includere test account login con guest mode (no real credentials)
Fornire revisori Apple un demo account per Sign in with Apple
